title: Karyalay structured log record v1
description: The shared subset of every Karyalay-authored structured log record. Repositories add fields; none renames or omits one defined here. Transcribed from Master §30.2, karyalay-mail §40.1 and karyalay-mail-infra §66.
$comment: Open by design: repo-local fields are expected and are not a validation failure. What this schema enforces is that the joinable fields are present, correctly typed, and that forbidden fields are absent.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC, high resolution where useful.

service.description: Emitting service, e.g. karyalay-mail, mail-control, infra-controller.

process_role.description: Role within the service (Repo 1 §40.1), e.g. mail-api, mail-outbox.

version.description: Release/config generation, so behaviour ties to deployed state (Repo 3 §66).

organisation_id.description: Present only when the tenant is already known and disclosure is permitted (Repo 3 §66).

error_code.description: A code from errors/error-catalog-v1.yaml. Null on success paths that carry the field.

message.description: Sanitized operator-safe description. Never the carrier of an essential structured field.

not.$comment: Master §30 and Repo 1 §38.2/§40.2 forbid these outright. Named here so a validator catches the mistake rather than a privacy review months later.
